what_happened.line: The Select Board and Planning Board members held a workshop on a draft earth removal bylaw and regulations; no vote was taken on it.
After residents criticised handling the Gilchrist Street land swap in closed session, the board voted to enter executive session on it.
The board ratified the town manager's appointment of a police lieutenant, effective August 14; the vote count was not audible.
The board approved election officer appointments through the 6/30/19 term and accepted the election warden's resignation with regret.
The board's three goals will be a standing old business item, and the next meeting was set for August 21, with three in September.

why_it_matters: An earth removal bylaw would set the rules for quarrying and sand and gravel operations in town, and a bylaw would likely come to Town Meeting for a vote.
The Gilchrist Street swap involves a town-owned strip exchanged for an easement, so it touches town land, trail access and how openly such deals are discussed.
watch_next: Next Select Board meeting on August 21, with three meetings set for September.
Any further draft of the earth removal bylaw and regulations, and any public action on the Gilchrist Street conveyance.
